architecture.summary: Refine the existing T2 architecture comparison comment policy with lessons from reviewed diagrams: pinned parent baselines and all-block inventory, source and contract evidence, clearly labeled supplementary views, precise component and operation identity, contract ownership, source versus runtime edges, local versus remote work, policy and payload changes, failure context, neutral unchanged boundaries, exact rendered sources, readable layout, manager feedback, and verified publication of one comment. This changes human-readable review guidance only. It adds no automated gate and changes no human approval, test, metrics, or merge authority. The context, container, component, runtime, and deployment views remain accurate: this candidate changes no application source, runtime configuration, component responsibilities, public application contracts, collaborations, resource lifetimes, external systems, or deployment placement. No registry edit is needed.
